scope: Static Toolkit 1.18 SENPIROA factory, class, VMT and inherited load-chain analysis; bounded Python cached/native projection; and a read-only projection of the matching unit in an unchanged VM project snapshot. The original executable was not executed; no database, CNI or physical device was mutated or accessed during the sweep.

static_facts.factory: The factory registers SENPIROA to the legacy TSENPIROA class from firmware 1.2.60 through 2.0.00 and to TST7SENPIROA from 2.0.01 through 9. The observed firmware 2.4.00 therefore selects TST7SENPIROA.
static_facts.interaction_slots: The selected class VMT resolves IsInteractionGroup to TCBusNeoInputUnit.IsInteractionGroup, which accepts zero-based slots 0 through 7.
static_facts.area: The selected class VMT resolves Area to TCBusInputUnit.GetAreaIfAvailable, which loads AreaGroupAddress and resolves it in the primary application on each call.
static_facts.group_associations: The ST7 PIR load path delegates through the multisensor and Neo input agents. The inherited core input LoadGroups path resolves input-block groups and appends each non-nil group to the unit group manager in block order. The admitted native shape retains all eight stored GroupAddress associations, including repeated address255 slots.

read_only_snapshot_sweep.source: unchanged GRENACHE.xml copied read-only from the user-owned Windows VM

focused_acceptance.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:. .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_selection tests.test_toolkit_database_csv tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_projection tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_native tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_area tests.test_cli_toolkit_database_csv

remaining_limits: SENPIRIA, SENPIRIB and other sensor profiles
